description:
A serene living room corner bathed in soft, natural daylight streaming through a large multi-pane wooden window on the left wall. The window frames a blurred green garden view beyond, casting warm diagonal shadow patterns across the cream plaster wall. The room's architecture is simple and clean — smooth off-white plaster walls meeting a flat white ceiling, with a shallow recessed niche visible in the upper right corner of the right wall, holding a small ceramic vessel.

The flooring is implied but not fully visible. A low, raw-timber console bench occupies the left-center foreground, its legs rough-hewn and unfinished, surface worn to a warm honey-brown. On the bench sit two wheel-thrown ceramic vases in matte bone and sand tones — one taller and narrow, one shorter and rounder — alongside a small potted fern in a textured natural clay pot, elevated on a stack of two softcover books with minimal typography on their spines.

To the right, a linen upholstered armchair in warm greige occupies the near-right foreground, its loose-cushioned seat and track arms suggesting casual comfort. A chunky hand-knit throw pillow in natural oat sits propped in the corner of the chair, and a draped linen throw in pale flax cascades over the arm. A woven rattan basket is partially visible at lower-left on the floor beside the bench leg.

On the upper-right wall, a woven flat rattan disc — roughly hat-shaped — hangs as decorative wall art. Warm ambient light suffuses the entire scene evenly, supplemented by a soft golden glow emanating downward into the center of the space, washing the wall behind the bench and casting a gentle warm pool across the bench surface and floor area below.

The overall palette is tightly controlled: warm whites, oat, flax, honey oak, and matte clay, with the fern's vivid green serving as the sole chromatic contrast. The atmosphere is calm, unhurried, and sun-warmed — mid-morning light, Nordic-Japanese in sensibility.

Camera is positioned at approximately seated eye-level, roughly 3–4 feet from the floor, with a normal to slightly wide lens character. The composition is a three-quarter corner view showing both the left wall with the window and the front-facing right wall simultaneously, with the bench and chair anchoring the lower third. The camera pitch is level with a very slight downward tilt toward the bench surface. The frame captures a focused room vignette rather than a full-room establishing shot.

A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
